text: Blessed are all who fear יהוה, Who walk in His ways.
You shall eat the labour of your hands. Be blessed, and let it be well with you.
Let your wife be As a fruit-bearing vine within your house, Your sons like olive plants all around your table.
Look, so shall the man be blessed Who fears יהוה.
יהוה shall bless you out of Tsiyon, And let you see the good of Yerushalayim All the days of your life,
And let you see your children’s children! Peace be upon Yisra’ĕl!
